message:
The other day, I found myself rummaging through the closet, looking for my old travel bag. It was one of those moments where I thought, "Why do I have so many bags?" But as I pulled it out, I remembered how I used to keep it stocked with essentials for quick trips. I decided to take a few minutes to refresh it with some snacks, a water bottle, and important documents. 

Then, wouldn't you know it, a sudden storm rolled through later that evening! I felt a wave of relief knowing I was prepared, even for the unexpected. It’s funny how a small win like that can bring such peace of mind. Have you checked your go-bag lately?
